answer: Contrarian-correctness bonus: once grading locks, the ledger opens a sealed reference verdict from a panel drawn only after submissions close. A juror whose score left the majority yet matched that reference earns double; one who trailed the crowd and erred loses bond. Sealed till settlement, the verdict cannot be bought ahead. A lockstep clone farm either follows the crowd for no bonus or deviates together and errs; each identity pays for real independent analysis. Dissent from a frozen tundra of consensus is cheap, but a raven echoing the flock, a willow bending with each vote, earns naught.
